headline: Arch Insurance Agrees to Acquire Premier Dealer Services
summary: Arch Insurance has reached an agreement to acquire Premier Dealer Services, expanding its specialty insurance and warranty product suite.
why: Arch Capital Group is a leading global insurer and reinsurer, active in specialty program roll-ups.
